versos.grego: Τρίτον τοῦτο ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς· ἐπὶ στόματος δύο μαρτύρων καὶ τριῶν σταθήσεται πᾶν ῥῆμα.

controles.web: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
controles.kjv: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
controles.livre: Esta é a terceira vez que venho até vós; pela boca de duas ou três testemunhas toda palavra será firmada.

versos.grego: προείρηκα καὶ προλέγω, ὡς παρὼν τὸ δεύτερον καὶ ἀπὼν νῦν, τοῖς προημαρτηκόσιν καὶ τοῖς λοιποῖς πᾶσιν, ὅτι ἐὰν ἔλθω εἰς τὸ πάλιν οὐ φείσομαι,

controles.web: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;
controles.kjv: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
controles.livre: Eu já tinha dito antes, e disse quando estive presente pela segunda vez, e agora ausente o escrevo aos que pecaram anteriormente, e a todos os demais, que se vier outra vez, não lhes serei tolerante;

versos.grego: ἐπεὶ δοκιμὴν ζητεῖτε τοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ λαλοῦντος Χριστοῦ, ὃς εἰς ὑμᾶς οὐκ ἀσθενεῖ ἀλλὰ δυνατεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν.

controles.web: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.
controles.kjv: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
controles.livre: Pois buscais prova de que Cristo fala em mim, o qual em vós não é fraco, mas que é poderoso entre vós.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ἐσταυρώθη ἐξ ἀσθενείας, ἀλλὰ ζῇ ἐκ δυνάμεως Θεοῦ. καὶ γὰρ ἡμεῖς ἀσθενοῦμεν ἐν αὐτῷ, ἀλλὰ ζήσομεν σὺν αὐτῷ ἐκ δυνάμεως Θεοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
controles.kjv: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
controles.livre: Porque ainda que tenha sido crucificado por fraqueza, contudo ele vive pelo poder de Deus. Porque também nós somos fracos nele, porém com ele viveremos pelo poder de Deus em vós.

versos.grego: Ἑαυτοὺς πειράζετε εἰ ἐστὲ ἐν τῇ πίστει, ἑαυτοὺς δοκιμάζετε· ἢ οὐκ ἐπιγινώσκετε ἑαυτοὺς ὅτι Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν; εἰ μήτι ἀδόκιμοί ἐστε.

controles.web: Test your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
controles.kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
controles.livre: Examinai-vos a vós mesmos, se estais na fé; provai-vos a vós mesmos. Ou não conheceis a vós mesmos, que Jesus Cristo está em vós? A menos que vós estejais reprovados.

versos.grego: ἐλπίζω δὲ ὅτι γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἐσμὲν ἀδόκιμοι.

controles.web: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
controles.kjv: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
controles.livre: Mas espero que vós entendereis que nós não somos reprovados.

versos.grego: εὐχόμεθα δὲ πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν μὴ ποιῆσαι ὑμᾶς κακὸν μηδέν, οὐχ ἵνα ἡμεῖς δόκιμοι φανῶμεν, ἀλλ’ ἵνα ὑμεῖς τὸ καλὸν ποιῆτε, ἡμεῖς δὲ ὡς ἀδόκιμοι ὦμεν.

controles.web: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we are as reprobate.
controles.kjv: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
controles.livre: E eu desejo pedindo a Deus que nenhum mal façais; não para que sejamos achados aprovados, mas para que vós façais o bem, e nós sejamos como reprovados.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ δυνάμεθά τι κατὰ τῆς ἀληθείας, ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ τῆς ἀληθείας.

controles.web: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
controles.kjv: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
controles.livre: Porque nada podemos fazer contra a verdade, mas sim pela verdade.

versos.grego: χαίρομεν γὰρ ὅταν ἡμεῖς ἀσθενῶμεν, ὑμεῖς δὲ δυνατοὶ ἦτε· τοῦτο καὶ εὐχόμεθα, τὴν ὑμῶν κατάρτισιν.

controles.web: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. And this we also pray for, even your perfecting.
controles.kjv: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
controles.livre: Pois nós nos alegramos quando estamos fracos, e vós estais fortes; e isto também desejamos: o vosso aperfeiçoamento.

versos.grego: Διὰ τοῦτο ταῦτα ἀπὼν γράφω, ἵνα παρὼν μὴ ἀποτόμως χρήσωμαι κατὰ τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἣν ὁ Κύριος ἔδωκέν μοι εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ εἰς καθαίρεσιν.

controles.web: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for tearing down.
controles.kjv: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
controles.livre: Por isso eu escrevo estas coisas ausente; para que, quando estiver presente não use de rigor, segundo o poder que o Senhor tem me dado, para edificação, e não para destruição.

versos.grego: Λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί, χαίρετε, καταρτίζεσθε, παρακαλεῖσθε, τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖτε, εἰρηνεύετε, καὶ ὁ Θεὸς τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθ’ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Be perfected, be comforted, be of the same mind, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
controles.kjv: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
controles.livre: Quanto às demais coisas, irmãos, alegrai-vos, sede íntegros, consolai-vos, tenhais um mesmo entendimento, vivei em paz; e o Deus de amor e paz será convosco.

versos.grego: Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν ἁγίῳ φιλήματι. Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἅγιοι πάντες.

controles.web: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the saints greet you.
controles.kjv: Greet one another with an holy kiss. All the saints salute you.
controles.livre: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com beijo santo. Todos os santos vos saúdam.

versos.grego: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἡ κοινωνία τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.

controles.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, be with you all. Amen.
controles.kjv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.  The second epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi, a city of Macedonia, by Titus and Lucas.
controles.livre: A graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo, e o amor de Deus, e a comunhão do Espírito Santo seja com todos vós. Amém.
